groups.defect: The postMessage origin check in embed.js uses substring containment (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)) instead of an exact origin comparison, so it can be bypassed.
groups.rationale: All three point at line 17 of embed.js and report the same substring-vs-exact origin check problem with the same fix.

groups.defect: PollFeed crashes when an RSS item has nil content (i.content.scrub); it also has no rescue around the open/parse network call.
groups.rationale: All three report the nil i.content.scrub crash in poll_feed. s_52c21f9e also reports unhandled network and parse errors.

groups.defect: The embed layout passes the full request.referer URL as the postMessage targetOrigin, which is not a valid origin, so the message is dropped. It is also interpolated without JS escaping, which allows XSS.
groups.rationale: Both report that the full referer URL used as targetOrigin causes the browser to drop the message. s_56e8eec5 adds the unescaped-interpolation XSS.

groups.defect: EmbedController#best enqueues a RetrieveTopic job, but the controller spec still expects a synchronous TopicRetriever.new.retrieve call.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same mismatch between the controller's async enqueue and the spec's TopicRetriever expectation, one from the controller and one from the spec.
